primary_question.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Hyderabadi Biryani?
evidence: Do not boil the milk hard, or the saffron aroma can fade.

related_questions.question: Why is my Hyderabadi Biryani too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not leave dry spice patches on the chicken.

related_questions.question: Why does my Hyderabadi Biryani taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not use high heat for the whole time, or the bottom can scorch.

related_questions.question: Why is my Hyderabadi Biryani turning out soggy?
evidence: Do not mix aggressively, or the rice can turn mushy.

related_questions.question: How can I improve my Hyderabadi Biryani?
evidence: Do not rub the rice too hard, or the grains may break.
Do not skip soaking, or the rice may cook unevenly.
Do not soak for many hours, or the grains can turn fragile.
Do not boil the milk hard, or the saffron aroma can fade.
Do not leave dry spice patches on the chicken.
